phase_selection.note: Measured GRF HS used only to select reset time; online actor FSM stays unchanged.

reference_contract.biological_support: original IK tracking, muscles and residual reserves
reference_contract.policy: frozen deterministic original evaluator; no PPO/critic/Adam update
reference_contract.zero_velocity: IK walking pose, biological speeds unchanged; prosthetic joint and matching SEA motor speeds zero; served reference remains original
reference_contract.random_bootstrap: q random; joint/rotor v0; rotor angle=q; controller PI0; governor q=random,v=a=0; biological IK/time and both GRF paths preserved; no target or fake HS initialization

random_pose_sampling.selection: First eligible candidates in fixed order; all preflight candidates and rejection reasons preserved
random_pose_sampling.rejections: No candidate redraws, adaptive bounds or outcome-based selection

strict_screening.scientific_qualification: These operational criteria do not certify general biomechanics or subject transfer
